description: Special Protection Areas (SPAs) are part of the Natura 2000 network of European sites, designated in accordance with the EU Birds Directive (79/409/EEC), to protect various threatened and migratory bird species. SPA boundaries are mapped using the Irish Grid (epsg. 29903) or Irish Transverse Mercator (epsg 2157) co-ordinate systems. Details of the co-ordinate system for each SPA site can be found in the attribute table of the shapefile.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry in WGS 84 (OGC:CRS84) after conversion; the service stores it in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157). The only column declared as geometry.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Internal row number of the ArcGIS service; not stable across data versions.

table:columns.name: SITECODE
table:columns.description: NPWS site code of the designated area, the key used across NPWS publications and at www.npws.ie/protected-sites.

table:columns.name: VERSION
table:columns.description: Version number of the site boundary as released by NPWS.

table:columns.name: COUNTY
table:columns.description: County or counties the site lies in, as recorded by NPWS.

table:columns.name: HA
table:columns.description: Area of the site in hectares as computed by NPWS.

table:columns.name: Source_CRS
table:columns.description: Coordinate reference system the site boundary was originally mapped in; NPWS notes that this varies per site between the Irish Grid, Irish Transverse Mercator and, for offshore marine sites, WGS 84.

table:columns.name: SourcScale
table:columns.description: Scale of the source mapping the boundary was digitised from.

table:columns.name: URL
table:columns.description: Link to the NPWS page for the site.

table:columns.name: Shape__Area
table:columns.description: Area computed by the ArcGIS service in the units of its spatial reference (Irish Transverse Mercator square metres); not derived from the converted WGS 84 geometry. Use the HA column or compute from geom.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: Perimeter computed by the ArcGIS service in the units of its spatial reference (Irish Transverse Mercator metres); not derived from the converted WGS 84 geometry.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry as a struct of xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, added by the GeoParquet conversion.
